channel.title: Code Notes made by Vaibhav Rathod
channel.description: Last 20 notes on Code Notes made by Vaibhav Rathod

item.title: Weighted & Unweighted Graphs
item.description: A comprehensive guide on Weighted and Unweighted Graphs. Covers edge weights representation in lists and matrices, and algorithmic contexts (Dijkstra, MST).

item.title: XOR Sum 1 to N
item.description: Learn the competitive programming trick to compute the bitwise XOR sum of all integers from 1 to N in O(1) time without looping.

item.title: Trie (Prefix Tree)
item.description: Master Trie (Prefix Tree) data structure in DSA. Learn how to implement prefix retrieval, search, insert, and build an autocomplete engine.

item.title: Segment Tree
item.description: Master Segment Trees in DSA. Learn to build segment trees for range sum/minimum queries, implement point updates, and optimize with Lazy Propagation.

item.title: Miscellaneous Snippets
item.description: A collection of quick python snippets for basic algorithms like factorial, frequency counting, leap year, and subarray sums.

item.title: Heap (Data Structure)
item.description: Master Heaps in Data Structures & Algorithms. Learn about binary heap representation, heapify operations, O(N) build-heap, and custom priority queue implementations.

item.title: Floyd Warshall Algorithm
item.description: Floyd-Warshall computes shortest paths between all pairs of vertices in O(V^3). Covers dynamic programming formulation, negative cycle detection, and path.

item.title: Floyds Cycle Detection
item.description: Floyd's cycle detection finds cycles in sequences using two pointers at different speeds. Covers cycle start detection, cycle length, O(n) time, O(1) space.

item.title: Gospers Hack
item.description: Learn Gosper's Hack, an advanced bitwise trick to generate the next integer with the same number of set bits in O(1) time.

item.title: Graph Representations
item.description: A comprehensive guide on Graph Representations. Covers Adjacency Matrix, Adjacency List, and Edge List, their complexity tradeoffs, and Python/C++ code.

item.title: Directed & Undirected Graphs
item.description: A comprehensive guide on Directed and Undirected Graphs. Covers edge directionality, vertex degrees, Handshaking Lemma, pathing concepts, and code.

item.title: Disjoint Set Data Structure
item.description: A comprehensive guide on the Disjoint-Set (Union-Find) data structure. Covers path compression, union by rank, complexity analysis, and Python/C++ implementations.

item.title: Euclids Algorithm
item.description: Euclid's algorithm computes the greatest common divisor efficiently using modular arithmetic. Covers extended Euclidean algorithm, Bezout's identity, and LCM.

item.title: FM index
item.description: A comprehensive guide to the FM-index (Ferragina-Manzini index). Covers suffix arrays, BWT construction, LF-mapping, backward search, complexity, and full Python/C++ implementations.

item.title: Fast Inverse Square Root
item.description: Discover the legendary fast inverse square root algorithm (0x5f3759df) from Quake III Arena for calculating 1/sqrt(x) without division.

item.title: Five Balltree Construction Algorithms
item.description: A comprehensive guide on spatial partitioning using Ball Trees. Details five construction algorithms, compares performance characteristics, and provides complete Python/C++ implementations.

item.title: Crit bit Trees
item.description: A comprehensive reference for Crit-bit Trees (PATRICIA tries). Covers critical bit indexing, binary branch traversal, insertions, deletions, and implementations in Python and C++.

item.title: Bitwise Hacks
item.description: Master advanced bitwise operations including Brian Kernighan's Algorithm, XOR Swaps, and Power of 2 checks.

item.title: A Search Algorithm
item.description: Comprehensive guide to the A* Search algorithm. Explains the f(n) = g(n) + h(n) evaluation, admissibility, consistency, distance metrics, and complete grid-based pathfinding in Python, C++, JavaScript, Java, and C.

item.title: AA Tree
item.description: Learn AA Trees, a simplified Red-Black Tree variant using levels instead of colors. Detailed skew, split, insert, delete operations in C++ and Python.
